hints.title: Two Order Configurations
hints.text: The subarray of length firstLen can appear entirely before the subarray of length secondLen, or vice versa. Evaluate both relative orders independently.

hints.title: Prefix Sum and Best Prior Window
hints.text: Construct prefix sums. As you slide the second window ending at index i, maintain the maximum sum of the first window that concluded at or before index i - length of second window.

hints.title: Bi-Directional Helper Function
hints.text: Write a helper function to calculate the maximum sum when length L strictly precedes length M. Return the maximum of helper(firstLen, secondLen) and helper(secondLen, firstLen).

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairs of non-overlapping windows directly takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking running maximums alongside prefix sums achieves O(N) linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should break into two cases (L before M, M before L) and maintain running best prefix sums.
complexity.notes: Can also be executed in O(1) space using sliding window accumulators.
